mapper.select: SELECT meal_record_id AS mealRecordId, member_id AS memberId, meal_date AS mealDate, meal_time AS mealTime, memo, meal_photo_url AS mealPhotoUrl, created_at AS createdAt FROM meal_record WHERE meal_record_id = #{mealRecordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meal_record ( member_id, meal_date, meal_time, memo, meal_photo_url ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{request.mealDate}, #{request.mealTime}, #{request.memo}, #{request.mealPhotoUrl} )

INSERT INTO food_item (meal_record_id, food_name, amount, nutrient_type, source_type) VALUES
(#{mealRecordId}, #{item.foodName}, #{item.amount}, #{item.nutrientType}, #{item.sourceType})
mapper.select: SELECT m.meal_record_id, m.member_id, m.meal_date, m.meal_time, m.memo, m.meal_photo_url, m.created_at AS created_at, f.food_item_id, f.food_name, f.amount, f.nutrient_type, f.source_type, f.created_at AS food_created_at FROM meal_record m LEFT JOIN food_item f ON m.meal_record_id = f.meal_record_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.meal_date = #{today} ORDER BY m.meal_time

SELECT mr.meal_record_id AS mealRecordId, mr.member_id AS memberId, mr.meal_date AS mealDate, mr.meal_time AS mealTime, mr.memo, mr.meal_photo_url AS mealPhotoUrl, mr.created_at AS createdAt FROM meal_record mr WHERE mr.meal_record_id = #{mealRecordId} AND mr.member_id = #{memberId}
